name: Ferry
description: Back up your game client settings!

menu-btn.name: Main Menu Button
menu-btn.description: Add the button for Ferry to the main menu.

sync-mods-loaded-only.name: Sync Settings for Loaded Mods Only to Cloud
sync-mods-loaded-only.description: Only upload settings for <cg>mods that are currently loaded</c> to the cloud. Otherwise, settings for <co>*all* mods</c> will be synced, <cr>whether they're enabled or disabled</c>.

also-title.name: Auto-Sync
also-title.description: Automatically sync <cf>Ferry</c> data alongside your Geometry Dash account.

also-upload.name: Sync to Cloud when Syncing Account
also-upload.description: Trigger the setting data upload process simultaneously when syncing your Geometry Dash account data to the cloud.

also-download.name: Load to Game when Loading Account
also-download.description: Trigger the setting data download process simultaneously when loading your Geometry Dash account data from the cloud.

auto-desc.description: Select what data will be automatically synced when you save or load your Geometry Dash account data.

auto-gamevars.name: Game Settings
auto-gamevars.description: Automatically sync your <cg>game settings</c> when triggering auto-sync.

auto-geode.name: Geode Loader Settings
auto-geode.description: Automatically sync your <cg>Geode loader settings</c> when triggering auto-sync.

auto-geode-mods.name: All Mods' Settings
auto-geode-mods.description: Automatically sync <cg>all of your mods' settings</c> when triggering auto-sync.
